thread:
jordan: incident-bot: GPU SIGBUS detected on pool-gamma, PagerDuty triggered (PD#INC-7890)
incident-bot: page fired to oncall rotation: eng-oncall
pagerduty: PagerDuty: Alert routed to oncall@redwood, use /ack to acknowledge
priya: acked — taking first responder
jordan: can you paste the dmesg and nvidia-smi from the instance?
priya: pulling logs, running: `kubectl logs -n inference pod/gamma-7 --tail=200`
priya: dmesg snippet:
```
[ 1234.567890] NVRM: Xid (PCI:0000:65:00): 31, Ch 00000001, PID 9876: Unsupported or uncorrectable error
[ 1234.567895] NVRM: Xid 31 detected: Xid Type: Graphics Exception
```
priya: nvidia-smi shows 0 processes but memory kernel flags indicate an error
sam: this looks like a SIGBUS pattern we've seen with certain driver+cuda combos after recent kernel update
jordan: is this isolated to pool-gamma or across pools?
iris: telemetry: 3 nodes in pool-gamma reported repeated Xid31 in last 2 minutes, other pools normal
priya: mitigation plan: 1) cordon + drain failing node, 2) fallback routing to pool-beta (lower perf) for affected customers, 3) restart inference runtime on drained node
jordan: start the drain, priya. I'll push a routing override to move critical customers.
priya: `kubectl cordon gamma-7 && kubectl drain gamma-7 --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data --force` :started
incident-bot: PagerDuty update: PD#INC-7890 acknowledged by priya at 15:42 UTC
sam: while draining, I suggest setting model fallback: `routing.override=pool-beta` for routes matching vip=critical-match
iris: doing a quick impact assessment: 7 active requests failed with OOM/SIGBUS in last 5m, 4 customers (acct: fastpay, cogent-ai, writely, tutorly) experienced increased tail latency or failed requests
jordan: notified SEs for the 4 customers, tagging @support
priya: node drained and pod evicted, restarting runtime service: `systemctl restart redwood-inference` — logs show recovery in progress
priya: post-restart, nvidia driver reports healthy, no Xid in last 60s
sam: routing override applied, customer traffic shifted to pool-beta. Latency for critical-match increased ~120ms but errors gone :thumbsup:
jordan: good. leave PD incident open until we confirm stability for 20m
incident-bot: PD#INC-7890 status: acknowledged -> investigating
iris: creating incident ticket INC-7890 in tracker, tagging oncall, eng-runtime, and eng-sre for postmortem
jordan: action items: (1) run driver compatibility sweep on pool-gamma images, (2) test kernel-driver combos in staging, (3) write playbook for SIGBUS handling
priya: noted. handing off to sam for overnight watch — @sam you'll take second responder? :eyes:
sam: taking handoff, will monitor for 2 hours and escalate if Xid reappears
jordan: thanks team — if anything flares, page again. we'll include this in next oncall review.
